$comment: GET /meetings/{meetingId} -- Zoom's core meeting-details read, the one MOIC's meeting bot needs to resolve a join link and its settings before dialling in. The path, scope (meeting:read:meeting) and top-level fields below matched three independent sources checked 2026-09-15 (Zoom's own docs index, its developer forum, and its blog); Zoom's detail page for this exact operation would not render for automated review, so the field list is the long-stable v2 shape rather than a byte-for-byte transcription of today's schema -- spot-check with a live call before this reaches a real account, and `npm run drift` will say if the shape has moved once a spec snapshot exists.
title: Get meeting
description: Read a Zoom meeting's join details and settings.

config.label: Meeting ID
config.description: The meeting's numeric id, from its join URL or from Zoom's own meeting list.

outputShape.description: The meeting's numeric id (also called the meeting number).
A unique id for THIS instance of a recurring meeting; the meeting id alone is shared across occurrences.
The Zoom user id of the meeting's host.
Zoom's numeric meeting type: 1 instant, 2 scheduled, 3 recurring with no fixed time, 8 recurring with a fixed time.
ISO 8601 with a Z offset, e.g. 2026-09-15T14:00:00Z.
An IANA zone Zoom uses to render start_time in its own UI, e.g. America/New_York.
The meeting's description, when the host set one.
The link a participant (or a meeting bot) uses to join.
The passcode required to join, when the meeting has one.
Whether Zoom holds joiners in a waiting room before admitting them -- a bot must be admitted like any guest.
Whether a participant may join before the host has started the meeting.
0 automatically approve, 1 manually approve, 2 no registration required.
